SL9_replacement_quantity_quality_capabil.law: With p=1-ell, replacement fraction r, q=(0.75+0.50*E_R)/(0.75+0.50*E), and all other capability factors fixed, C_after/C_before=(p+r)^(-0.28)*(p+r*q).
SL9_replacement_quantity_quality_capabil.one_for_one_corollary: If r=ell, headcount is restored exactly but C_after/C_before=1-ell*(1-q). If E_R<E and ell>0, capability remains below its pre-loss level.
SL9_replacement_quantity_quality_capabil.full_restoration: The full-capability replacement fraction r_star is the unique nonnegative solution of (p+r_star)^(-0.28)*(p+r_star*q)=1. For E_R<E, r_star>ell.

production_capability_verification.tested_against: production combat::capability() on an initialized military formation with all non-personnel/non-experience factors frozen

default_synthetic_example_E_0_9_E_R_0_1.interpretation: With Pineland's default synthetic experience values, restoring veteran losses one-for-one restores nominal headcount but not modeled combat capability. More than one low-experience replacement per veteran loss is required to restore the pre-loss capability component.

SL8_corollary: Under the uncapped matched-contact conditions of SL8, any SL9 capability ratio m maps to own-loss multiplier m^-0.45, opponent-loss multiplier m^0.45, and exchange-ratio multiplier m^0.90.
claim_boundary: SL9 is an exact conditional theorem of Pineland's synthetic personnel, replacement-memory, and combat-capability equations. The numerical replacement ratios are not empirical military estimates.
